name: obsidian
description: Build and maintain an Obsidian knowledge base: organize PDFs, extract figures, create source reading notes, clean web clippings, research queued topics, create interlinked wiki entries, and maintain links and maps of content.

interface.shortDescription: Build an Obsidian wiki from documents and researched topics
interface.longDescription: Build and maintain an Obsidian knowledge base: organize PDFs, extract figures, create source reading notes, clean web clippings, research queued topics, create interlinked wiki entries, and maintain links and maps of content.
defaultPrompt: Organize the PDFs and process the web clippings in my Obsidian inbox.
Research the unchecked topics in add-to-wiki.md and add missing wiki entries.
Audit the wiki entries and rebuild my maps of content.
